page.title: Bulk Shipments
page.subtitle: Book many Next Day COD shipments at once from a CSV file. Enter your pickup address once, upload the recipients, and review every shipment before anything is booked.
page.historyEmpty: No bulk batches yet. Upload a CSV to get started.

upload.title: Upload a CSV
upload.body: Enter the pickup address, download the template, add one shipment per row, then upload the CSV. Nothing is booked until you review and confirm.
upload.drop: Drop your CSV here, or choose a file
upload.limits: .csv only · up to {size} KB · up to {rows} shipments per file
upload.formatRequired: The CSV has exactly these 8 columns, all required:
upload.formatDate: date: the delivery date, YYYY-MM-DD (or DD/MM/YYYY). Bulk shipments are Next Day, so the earliest date is tomorrow.
upload.formatCod: cod_amount: the cash in AED the driver collects from the recipient — more than 0.
upload.formatPhone: recipient_phone: UAE format such as +971501234567 or 0501234567. Other countries are accepted but flagged.
upload.formatAddresses: delivery_address: as you would search for it on a map — building, area and emirate. No coordinates needed; ParcelLink finds them.
upload.pickupPlaceholder: Building, street, area and emirate — e.g. Bay Square 3, Business Bay, Dubai
upload.pickupHelp: Where the driver collects every shipment in this file. You enter it once — not in the CSV.
upload.fixedCod: All shipments: COD (cash collected from the recipient)
upload.formatNotNeeded: Not needed in the file: pickup address, delivery type, COD type, package value, notes, fragile, pickup contact, distance, coverage or delivery fee. Files made from the old template are refused — download the latest one.
upload.formatExcel: Using the Excel template? Fill in the Shipments tab, then save it as "CSV UTF-8" and upload that CSV. Lines above the column names are guidance and are skipped.

review.title: Bulk Shipment Review
review.subtitle: From {file}. Fix or remove rows with errors, then confirm to book.
review.checkingNote: Each delivery address is verified with Google Maps and checked for coverage. You can keep this page open while it runs.
review.editBody: Correct the values below. Saving checks this row again. The pickup address, Next Day delivery and COD apply to the whole batch.
review.removeBody: This row will be left out of the batch. It won't be booked.
review.readOnly: Uploaded by {name}. Only they can edit, check or book this batch — you can view it.

validation.positiveWhole: Must be a whole number of at least 1.
validation.positiveNumber: Must be a number greater than 0.
validation.dateTooFar: Must be within {days} days from today.
validation.nextDayToday: Bulk shipments are Next Day delivery — choose tomorrow or later.
validation.extraCells: This row has more values than there are columns — an address with a comma probably needs "quotes" around it.
validation.codPositive: Enter the cash to collect from the recipient — more than 0.
validation.codMax: The COD amount can be at most AED {max}.

issues.nonUaePhone: Not a UAE number — check that the courier can reach it.
issues.duplicate: Same as row {row}. Remove it if it's an accidental copy.
issues.addressNotFound: Could not verify this address. Add the building, area and emirate.
issues.addressTooGeneral: Too general — this only names a city or emirate. Add the building, street or area.
issues.addressApproximate: Only partly matched. We'll deliver to: {address}. Check this is right.
issues.checkFailed: This row couldn't be checked. Edit and save it to try again.

errors.tooLarge: This file is too large. Split it into smaller files.
errors.missingColumns: Missing required columns: {columns}. Download the latest template to see the expected format.
errors.tooMany: This file has {count} shipments; the maximum per file is {max}. Split it into smaller files.
errors.unclosedQuote: This file has a quote (") that is never closed, so it can't be read reliably. Check the file and upload it again.
errors.uploadFailed: The file couldn't be uploaded. Please try again.
errors.notMerchant: Bulk shipments are available to approved merchant accounts.
errors.notDraft: This batch can no longer be changed.
errors.loadFailed: The rows couldn't be loaded. Refresh the page.
errors.checkFailed: Checking stopped part-way. Try again to continue.
errors.removeFailed: The row couldn't be removed. Please try again.
errors.cancelFailed: The batch couldn't be discarded. Please try again.
errors.bookingInProgress: This batch is already being booked.
errors.stillValidating: Some rows are still being checked. Wait for them to finish, then book.
errors.nothingToBook: There are no valid rows to book.
errors.changedSinceReview: {count, plural, one {# row has} other {# rows have}} changed since you reviewed them (price, coverage or date). Review the updated rows and confirm again.
errors.bookingFailed: The shipments couldn't be booked. Nothing was created — please try again.
errors.bookingInterrupted: The last booking attempt was interrupted before anything was created. You can book again.
errors.bookingUnknown: We couldn't confirm the booking (connection lost). Refresh to see whether it went through — booking again will never create duplicates.
errors.cardUnavailable: Card payment isn't available for bulk bookings yet. Choose cash.
errors.outdatedTemplate: This CSV format is outdated (it has {columns}). Please download the latest bulk shipment template — the pickup address is now entered once on this page.
errors.unknownColumns: This file has columns ParcelLink does not use: {columns}. Remove them, or download the latest template.
errors.repeatedColumns: These columns appear more than once: {columns}.
errors.pickupRequired: Enter the pickup address first (building, area and emirate).
errors.pickupNotFound: Could not verify this pickup address. Add the building, area and emirate.
errors.pickupTooGeneral: This pickup address is too general — it only names a city or emirate. Add the building, street or area.
errors.outdatedDraft: This batch was uploaded with the old template and can no longer be booked. Upload the file again with the latest template.

book.discardBody: All uploaded rows will be removed. Nothing has been booked, so nothing else changes.
book.confirm: Confirm & Book {count, plural, one {# Shipment} other {# Shipments}}
book.confirmTitle: Book {count, plural, one {# shipment} other {# shipments}}?
book.confirmBody: {count, plural, one {# shipment} other {# shipments}} will be booked. Total delivery fees: {fees}. Total COD to collect: {cod}.
book.confirmSkipped: {count, plural, one {# row with errors} other {# rows with errors}} will not be booked.

confirmPayment.cod: Delivery fees are paid in cash; shipments go straight to dispatch.
confirmPayment.card: Card payment isn't live yet: shipments wait for payment before dispatch.

book.nothing: Fix at least one row to book.
book.cashOnly: Card payment isn't available for bulk bookings yet — delivery fees are paid in cash.

state.bookingBody: This page updates by itself. Shipments are created all together, so the batch is never left half-booked.
state.bookedTitle: {count, plural, one {# shipment booked.} other {# shipments booked.}}
state.bookedBody: Each has its own tracking ID and is now with our dispatch team. Download the shipment report to match tracking IDs to your orders.

labels.download: {count, plural, one {Download label} other {Download all # labels}}
labels.title: All labels
labels.ready: {count, plural, one {One PDF page, ready to print on A5 or A4.} other {One PDF file, one label per A5 page, ready to print on A5 or A4.}}
labels.empty: This bulk shipment has no shipments, so there are no labels to print.
labels.failed: Unable to generate all labels. Please try again.
labels.failedList: {count, plural, one {This shipment’s label couldn’t be made:} other {These # shipments’ labels couldn’t be made:}}
labels.partOf: Labels {first}–{last} of {total} (part {part} of {parts}). Large bulk shipments print in parts so the browser stays responsive.
labels.downloadPdf: {count, plural, one {Download label (PDF)} other {Download all # labels (PDF)}}
labels.included: {count, plural, one {# label in this file} other {# labels in this file}}
